notes: Worker handle table; iteration must not define externally visible wake ordering.
Debugger session handle table; lookup by opaque session id only.
Static asset route lookup; response ordering must come from explicit manifests.
Package download handle table; lookup by generated download id only.
TCP listener and stream registries are lookup by numeric handle; scheduling order must be explicit.
TLS plan registries are lookup by name/listener; exported plan order must be sorted if exposed.
UDP socket and address registries are lookup tables; receive ordering lives in explicit queues.
WebSocket session registry imports remain owned by the named state module.
WebSocket sessions are lookup by session id; broadcast and close order must be explicit.
